name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User device confirmed the Test12 normalized folder fileId fix closes search-folder navigation, so development can continue from the established search/file-management baseline.

features: add a dedicated 115OfflineCenter page without replacing the validated external magnet/offline execution chain
add a prominent entry to the existing normal 115Offline task page while leaving focusMode external magnet handling untouched
show current offline tasks with all/active/completed/failed filters and explicit manual refresh
allow adding magnet/ed2k/HTTP(S) tasks with the existing save-directory priority: 海阔视界, then 云下载/离线下载, then root
completed tasks reuse the existing 115OfflineResult page for video/result browsing
long-press removal deletes only the offline task record and keeps downloaded files
failed tasks can be removed and resubmitted using existing 115Api client methods

safety.taskListing: one listOfflineTask call per page load
safety.saveDirectoryLookup: only on explicit new-task submission when cached target is unavailable

validationTarget: existing search and folder navigation remain unchanged
existing external magnet call still follows the validated low-frequency focusMode chain
normal offline page shows a new 离线下载中心 entry
center can list tasks and switch filters
manual refresh updates progress without automatic polling
new task submission saves to the expected target directory
completed task opens existing result page
removing a task record does not delete downloaded files
